assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a single exceptionally believable professional product photograph, square 1536x1536. Reference 1 is exact Eon Coatings logo identity to reproduce at bottom right of printed graphic. Reference 2 is original badge design inspiration only, reference 3 is original plaque silhouette inspiration only. Redesign with a matching restrained teal and white print graphic: deep teal #214d57, fresh teal #35aaa0, white, understated two-tone geometric pattern. No gold, chrome, luminous effects, fantasy badge, embossing or AI-art gloss. Graphic is manufacturable flat printed ink. Sparse precisely legible text. Top HealthGuard in clean white sans serif, bold main title at middle, bottom row white QR square at left and Eon Coatings logo at right with CERTIFIED directly under the logo. QR is intentionally decorative fictional placeholder pattern, not actual credentials, no encoded destination required. Do not include SAMPLE, watermark, invented certification number, institute name, extra wording, flags, dates or medical claims. Product occupies about 70% of square frame, entirely visible, gently imperfect physical surface, quiet neutral surroundings. Subject: a real thin rounded-square matte vinyl sticker adhered perfectly flat against an off-white lightly textured interior wall. At most a fraction-of-mm vinyl edge, absolutely no thickness or sculpted frame, no drop-shadow hovering. Camera nearly front on, very mild natural perspective. Entire badge legible and fully visible with modest wall margin. Soft side daylight gives subtle texture, believable real commercial print photography. Exact text: "HealthGuard", "MULTI-SURFACE", "PROTECTION", "CERTIFIED", and the provided Eon Coatings logo. Main title two lines in upper-middle; bottom-left decorative QR and bottom-right Eon logo aligned. Modern polished print design, no overlapping elements. One badge only.
assets.qa: Visually inspected: clean correct text; Eon Coatings logo and CERTIFIED bottom right; decorative QR bottom left; no SAMPLE; entire physical object visible; badge flat on wall, plaque on metal slot holder. Matched teal/white graphic language. Concept mockup only.
